messages:
Noah P.: Hi all — quick heads up: my neurologist confirmed vestibular migraines that get triggered by fluorescent lights and open-plan office noise. Doctor recommended temporary quiet workspace + dimmer lighting for ~10 weeks while we try adjustments. Would like to request accommodation.
Evelyn - Eng Lead: Thanks for sharing, Noah. Absolutely we can support that. Would you prefer working from home most days or a reservable quiet room at the office?
Noah P.: Prefer office quiet room 3 days/wk (close to my team) and WFH 2 days. Also need to delay my end-of-cycle 1:1 calibration meeting by 3 weeks if possible — docs say cognitive symptoms can affect review prep.
Jordan (People Ops): We can do both. Please send a short medical note to people-ops@redwood.com (brief ok). We'll mark this as a temporary accommodation, draft a coverage plan for any meeting conflicts, and delay the calibration meeting by 3 weeks. We keep everything private.
Office Ops Bot: Quiet room booking: pending. Please confirm desired days and we will reserve Room Q3 near Eng.
Noah P.: Preferred office days: Tue/Thu/Fri. I'll email the note later today. Thanks.
Evelyn - Eng Lead: I'll update the performance timeline and ping the calibration group to postpone your slot. For meetings you cannot attend, we can record and have a teammate summarize.
Jordan (People Ops): Noted. We'll ship a desk lamp with adjustable warmth and a set of noise-cancelling headphones. Expect shipping in 3-5 business days. Check-in cadence: 2 weeks.
Noah P.: Appreciate it. Quick Q — will WFH days require manager approval each week?
Evelyn - Eng Lead: No, the approved schedule will be the template for the 10-week period; if you need changes, DM me.
Jordan (People Ops): Accommodation logged (ID: AC-2026-330). People Ops will follow up within 2 business days after we receive the note to finalize the private plan.
Noah P.: Sent the note to people-ops@redwood.com. Thanks everyone 1 feeling much better about this.
Evelyn - Eng Lead: Thanks for flagging early. Team, please keep medical details private.
Office Ops Bot: Room Q3 reserved for Tue/Thu/Fri (0900-1700) for next 10 weeks.
Jordan (People Ops): Closing loop: we'll touch base in 2 weeks and at 5 weeks for status.
